description: Deprecated: works until 2027-01-12. Same as tickerbot_query_news; call that instead.

cursor.description: From a prior response's `next_cursor`. Send it with the same params as the first page (`limit` may change). It holds the position and pins the read: a page whose params differ from the first page's, or a cursor sent alone, is a 400 naming the param to send.

from.description: Earliest `time_published` (inclusive), in strict ISO: `YYYY-MM-DD` or `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM[:SS]Z`. A bare date starts at 00:00 ET that day.

group_by.description: Comma-separated group keys, 1-6 (max 1000 chars); the response becomes rollups. `ticker` rolls up per ticker mentioned. Name a key with `AS` to choose its JSON key; an un-named expression is named for you.

having.description: Only with `group_by`. HAVING clause on the rollup (max 1000 chars).

limit.description: Page size (articles) / max groups (a `group_by` rollup). Articles take up to 1000 until 2027-01-12, then 100, and page the rest with `next_cursor`. A rollup does not page: it returns up to `limit` groups, every group up to 1000 by default, and sets `truncated: true` when there are more. A larger value is clamped to the max, not an error; see Deprecations.

min_relevance.description: Only with `ticker` or `universe`. Keeps an article only when it is about one of the tickers, meaning that ticker's `relevance` (0 to 1) is at least this value. `0.8` drops passing mentions. Omitted: every article that mentions them. `400` without a ticker scope; in `q`, filter the mention itself: `ticker = 'NVDA' AND relevance >= 0.8`.

order.description: Sort by a bare field name or SELECT alias only (put expressions in `select` and order by their alias). Defaults to `time_published` (articles) or `volume` (rollups; with your own `select` that has no `volume` column, its last column's alias).

q.description: WHERE clause over news articles. Max 4000 chars. Required unless `search`, `ticker`, `universe`, `from` or `to` is present. Takes every article field under Returns except `mentions`, plus the per-mention fields `ticker`, `relevance`, `sentiment_score` and `sentiment` (one article per mention).

search.description: Full-text search over `title` + `summary`, in websearch grammar: `nvidia earnings` (all words), `"price target"` (phrase), `chips OR semiconductors`, `-crypto` (negation). Max 200 chars. ANDs with `q` and the other filters. Language-stemmed English.

select.description: Fields or expressions to return (max 2000 chars). Defaults to the article row (no `group_by`) or `<group_by keys>, COUNT(*) AS volume` (with `group_by`). `*` returns every article field under Returns plus `mentions` (on a per-mention row, the mention's four fields too). `mentions` is selectable on its own.

ticker.description: One ticker or a comma list (up to 50): articles that mention any of them. Not combinable with `universe`. Per-mention rows still list every ticker an article mentions; put `ticker = 'NVDA'` in `q` for one ticker's rows.

to.description: Articles strictly before this instant, in the same strict ISO subset as `from` (as on `/v2/events`). A bare `YYYY-MM-DD` means through the end of that day (the ET calendar day), so `from` and `to` on the same date return that day.

universe.description: Scope to a built-in universe (`top_10`, `top_100`) or one of your own, by id. An unknown one answers 200 with no results and its id in `not_found`. Articles that mention any member. Not combinable with `ticker`.

name: tickerbot_search_news
